authority: Cambridge 9618 syllabus 2027-2029 Version 2 and the project's teach-before-assess contract

records.resolution: Changed L001-Q1 to a storage-unit context and mapped bitmap-header assessment to L008-Q1 and AQ011-Q3.
Restricted AM081-Q4 to flat-file, relational and DBMS foundations taught by L081; retained SQL assessment after L085.
Made AQ101-Q5 assess L101 control structures and moved flowchart-to-pseudocode assessment to AQ106-Q1 after L102.
Restricted the Section 9 review item to scalar identifier-table entries and mapped array terminology to AQ116-Q5.
Replaced the premature ADT comparison with an array-of-records task; mapped ADT assessment to Quiz 125 and L123.
Replaced the premature lifecycle comparison with a Section 11 modular-program design task; mapped lifecycle assessment to L143-Q2 and AQ146-Q2.
Added a visible CORE array/index/bounds prerequisite bridge at the start of L105 before search and sort.
Removed the over-broad dependency on completing every register type; L043 depends on the architecture foundation taught in L042 and defines the registers it transfers.
Removed the over-broad dependency on completing the full bus requirement; the architecture/bus foundation is already visible in L042 before L043 notation.
